segments.name: Payment Services
segments.description: Operates a global digital payments network providing authorization, clearing, settlement and value-added services to financial institutions, sellers, consumers and governments.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment, Payment Services.

revenueModel.text: Visa earns service, data processing, international transaction and other revenue from financial institution clients, sellers and partners for payment transaction processing, value-added services, brand licensing and currency conversion.
revenueModel.evidence: Visa earns revenue by facilitating money movement across more than 200 countries and territories, among a global set of consumers, sellers, financial institutions and government entities, through innovative technologies.
